16406-an-introduction-to-philosophy.title: An Introduction To Philosophy
16406-an-introduction-to-philosophy.creator: George Stuart Fullerton
16406-an-introduction-to-philosophy.description: A book by George Stuart Fullerton. In the Notes in the back of this volume, the reader will find references to those parts of the larger work which treat of the subjects more briefly discussed here. It will be helpful to the teacher to keep the larger work on hand, and to use more or less of the material there presented as his undergraduate classes discuss the chapters of this one.

74548-great-short-stories-volume-1-of-3.title: Great Short Stories Volume 1 Of 3
74548-great-short-stories-volume-1-of-3.creator: Edgar Allan Poe
74548-great-short-stories-volume-1-of-3.description: A book by Edgar Allan Poe. incipally from abroad, they were first published 1841-5. Soon afterward "The Murders in the Rue Morgue" was translated into French and appeared in several French journals, notably the "Charivari."  This constituted Poe's introduction to a French audience, and it won for him a warmer and a more general recognition than he has ever had in this country.

arxiv-1805-07335.title: A new construction of the degree of maximal monotone maps
arxiv-1805-07335.creator: Mohammad Niksirat
arxiv-1805-07335.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by Mohammad Niksirat. The inclusion equations of the type f ∈ T ⁡ ( x ) f\in T(x) where T : X → 2 X ∗ T:X\to 2^{X^{\ast}} is a maximal monotone map, are extensively studied in nonlinear analysis. In this paper, we present a new construction of the degree of maximal monotone maps of the form T : Y → 2 X ∗ T:Y\to 2^{X^{*}} , where Y Y is a locally uniformly convex and separable Banach space continuously embedded in X X .

arxiv-1902-07654.title: A Two-Level Distributed Algorithm for Nonconvex Constrained Optimization
arxiv-1902-07654.creator: Kaizhao Sun, X. Andy Sun
arxiv-1902-07654.description: Abstract This paper aims to develop distributed algorithms for nonconvex optimization problems with complicated constraints associated with a network. The network can be a physical one, such as an electric power network, where the constraints are nonlinear power flow equations, or an abstract one that represents constraint couplings between decision variables of different agents.

arxiv-2206-08903.title: Colonoscopy 3D video dataset with paired depth from 2D-3D registration Journal: Medical Image Analysis
arxiv-2206-08903.creator: Taylor L. Bobrow, Mayank Golhar, Rohan Vijayan, Venkata S. Akshintala, Juan R. Garcia, Nicholas J. Durr
arxiv-2206-08903.description: Abstract Screening colonoscopy is an important clinical application for several 3D computer vision techniques, including depth estimation, surface reconstruction, and missing region detection. However, the development, evaluation, and comparison of these techniques in real colonoscopy videos remain largely qualitative due to the difficulty of acquiring ground truth data.

arxiv-2212-09802.title: Panoptic Lifting for 3D Scene Understanding with Neural Fields
arxiv-2212-09802.creator: Yawar Siddiqui Lorenzo Porzi Samuel Rota Bulò, Norman Müller Matthias Nießner Angela Dai Peter Kontschieder, Technical University of Munich Meta Reality Labs Zurich
arxiv-2212-09802.description: Abstract We propose Panoptic Lifting, a novel approach for learning panoptic 3D volumetric representations from images of in-the-wild scenes. Once trained, our model can render color images together with 3D-consistent panoptic segmentation from novel viewpoints. Unlike existing approaches which use 3D input directly or indirectly, our method requires only machine-generated 2D panoptic segmentation masks inferred from a pre-trained network.

arxiv-2301-06121.title: Port-Hamiltonian structure of interacting particle systems and its mean-field limit
arxiv-2301-06121.creator: Birgit Jacob , Claudia Totzeck
arxiv-2301-06121.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Birgit Jacob , Claudia Totzeck. We derive a minimal port-Hamiltonian formulation of a general class of interacting particle systems driven by alignment and potential-based force dynamics which include the Cucker-Smale model with potential interaction and the second order Kuramoto model. The port-Hamiltonian structure allows to characterize conserved quantities such as Casimir functions as well as the long-time behaviour using a LaSalle-type argument on the particle level.

arxiv-2311-12149.title: Wave Generation by Flare-Accelerated Ions and Implications for 3 He Acceleration
arxiv-2311-12149.creator: A. Fitzmaurice, J. F. Drake, M. Swisdak
arxiv-2311-12149.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by A. Fitzmaurice, J. F. Drake, M. Swisdak. The waves generated by high-energy proton and alpha particles streaming from solar flares into regions of colder plasma are explored using particle-in-cell simulations. Initial distribution functions for the protons and alphas consist of two populations: an energetic, streaming population represented by an anisotropic ( T ∥ > T ⟂ T_{\parallel}>T_{\perp} ), one-sided kappa function and a cold, Maxwellian background population.

arxiv-2404-11314.title: Destructive and Constructive RIS Beamforming in an ISAC Multi-User MIMO Network Thanks: This work was supported by the SUCCESS project (FUS21-0026), funded by the Swedish Foundation for Strategic Research.
arxiv-2404-11314.creator: Steven Rivetti †, Özlem Tu g ˘ \breve{\text{g}} fe Demir *, Emil Björnson †, Mikael Skoglund †
arxiv-2404-11314.description: Abstract Integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) has already established itself as a promising solution to the spectrum scarcity problem, even more so when paired with a reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS), as RISs can shape the propagation environment by adjusting their phase-shift coefficients. Albeit the potential performance gain, a RIS is also a potential security threat to the system.

arxiv-2505-15637.title: Oral Imaging for Malocclusion Issues Assessments: OMNI Dataset, Deep Learning Baselines and Benchmarking
arxiv-2505-15637.creator: Pujun Xue, Junyi Ge, Xiaotong Jiang, Siyang Song *, Zijian Wu, Yupeng Huo, Weicheng Xie, Linlin Shen, Xiaoqin Zhou, Xiaofeng Liu *, Min Gu *
arxiv-2505-15637.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Pujun Xue, Junyi Ge, Xiaotong Jiang, Siyang Song *, Zijian Wu, Yupeng Huo, Weicheng Xie, Linlin Shen, Xiaoqin Zhou, Xiaofeng Liu *, Min Gu *. Malocclusion is a major challenge in orthodontics, and its complex presentation and diverse clinical manifestations make accurate localization and diagnosis particularly important.

arxiv-2601-18246.title: Tensor-driven geometric phase in nonlinear AlGaAs metasurfaces
arxiv-2601-18246.creator: Giorgio Guercio, Andrea Gerini, Kristina Frizyuk, Martina Morassi, Aristide Lemaître, Costantino De Angelis, Luca Carletti, Giuseppe Leo
arxiv-2601-18246.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Giorgio Guercio, Andrea Gerini, Kristina Frizyuk, Martina Morassi, Aristide Lemaître, Costantino De Angelis, Luca Carletti, Giuseppe Leo. Dielectric metasurfaces provide a unique platform for efficient harmonic generation and optical wavefront manipulation at the nanoscale. While several approaches are available for performing wavefront shaping, the one exploiting geometric phase streamlines significantly the design and fabrication process.

arxiv-2602-07919.title: Selective Fine-Tuning for Targeted and Robust Concept Unlearning
arxiv-2602-07919.creator: Mansi, Avinash Kori, Francesca Toni, Soteris Demetriou
arxiv-2602-07919.description: Abstract Text-guided diffusion models are used by millions of users, but can be easily exploited to produce harmful content. Concept unlearning methods aim at reducing the models’ likelihood of generating harmful content. Traditionally, this has been tackled at an individual concept level, with only a handful of recent works considering more realistic concept combinations.

pmc-10553144.title: Short-term results of endoscopic calcaneoplasty and retrocalcaneal bursectomy for insertional Achilles tendinopathy
pmc-10553144.creator: Se-Hwan Lee, Kwang-Bok Lee
pmc-10553144.description: Although open surgery has traditionally been used as a surgical treatment for insertional Achilles tendinopathy, there is a possibility of serious complications (avulsion, scarring, contracture, sensory changes, and infection) due to the anatomical characteristics of the area. Endoscopic surgery has some advantages due to the smaller incision needed.

pmc-11434660.title: Baked Egg Oral Immunotherapy: Current State in Pediatric Age
pmc-11434660.creator: Simone Foti Randazzese, Lucia Caminiti, Mariarosaria La Rocca, Cristina Italia, Fabio Toscano, Francesca Galletta, Giuseppe Crisafulli, Sara Manti, Carlos Pastor-Vargas
pmc-11434660.description: Hen’s egg allergy is one of the most common food allergies in the Western world, with an increase in recent years. It affects about 9.5% of the pediatric population, and the onset most often occurs before the first year of life. The occurrence of spontaneous oral tolerance acquisition varies among studies, but it is generally high by school age.

pmc-11445659.title: Efficacy and safety of using a unilateral lower limb exoskeleton combined with conventional treatment in post-stroke rehabilitation: a randomized controlled trial
pmc-11445659.creator: Ying Jin, Bing Xiong, Lina Chen, Weiwei Zhao, Zhe Li, Chi Zhang, Xin Xu
pmc-11445659.description: IntroductionThe incidence of hemiplegia caused by stroke is high. In particular, lower limb dysfunction affects the daily activities of patients, and lower limb robotic devices have been proposed to provide rehabilitation therapy to improve balance function in this patient population.

pmc-11467541.title: Experimental studies on the cooling and heating performance of a highly emissive coating
pmc-11467541.creator: Zhuo Yang, Zhangran Yang, Zihan Zhang, Yuanzhu Cai, Xingjian Wang, Yanwen Li, Ruohan Zhang, Yangang Zhang, Lianhua Liu, Weidong Zhang, Lijin Xu, Peng Wang
pmc-11467541.description: In this study, the cooling effect below ambient air temperature, heat dissipation properties and heating energy efficacy of a superomniphobic self-cleaning (SSC) highly emissive (HE) coating were systematically investigated. Except at midday, the SSC-HE coating with an extremely high solar reflectance of 0.985 showed a better cooling effect than a 10-cm-thick polyurethane insulation layer.

pmc-11640867.title: Polysaccharide-Based Packaging Coatings and Films with Phenolic Compounds in Preservation of Fruits and Vegetables—A Review
pmc-11640867.creator: Junkun Pan, Chengheng Li, Jiechao Liu, Zhonggao Jiao, Qiang Zhang, Zhenzhen Lv, Wenbo Yang, Dalei Chen, Hui Liu, Monique Lacroix
pmc-11640867.description: Considerable interest has emerged in developing biodegradable food packaging materials derived from polysaccharides. Phenolic compounds serve as natural bioactive substances with a range of functional properties. Various phenolic compounds have been incorporated into polysaccharide-based films and coatings for food packaging, thereby enhancing product shelf life by mitigating quality degradation due to oxidation and microbial growth.

pmc-12535069.title: Drug repurposing in oncology: a systematic review of anticancer effects of Lanatoside C at the molecular level
pmc-12535069.creator: Oluwatobi O. Olayode, Tolulope J. Oladosu, Ajibola I. Abioye, Emmanuel Olusola Oladeji, Blessing T. Ogunoye
pmc-12535069.description: Cancer continues to pose a major global health burden, with rising incidence and mortality rates. The protracted timelines, and high costs associated with traditional drug development highlight the urgent need for alternative drug development strategies. Drug repurposing, which involves identifying new anticancer uses for existing FDA-approved drugs, offers a promising and cost-effective approach.

pmc-13210914.title: Neuromagnetism “On the Cheap”: Evaluating a Combined Cylindrical Shield and Partial-Coverage OPM-MEG System for Detecting Sensorimotor Responses in Humans
pmc-13210914.creator: Lyam M. Bailey, Clara Knox, Timothy Bardouille
pmc-13210914.description: Background: Optically pumped magnetometers (OPMs) have emerged as a promising technology for neuromagnetic recording in humans. Current state-of-the-art OPM systems are housed in large magnetically shielded rooms to reduce external electromagnetic noise and typically comprise sensor arrays covering the entire head.

pmc-13482825.title: A hybrid NSGA II-CNN-LSTM model for optimal operation of hydropower reservoirs based on the day-ahead electricity price forecast
pmc-13482825.creator: Mohammadreza Heidarpanah, Farhad Hooshyaripor, Meisam Fazeli, Mehrdad Goodarzi
pmc-13482825.description: Hydropower is one of the renewable and affordable energy sources, though it may cause environmental impacts that require sustainable management. To ensure sustainability, hydropower producers must adopt a multi-dimensional approach to reservoir operation, balancing reservoir conditions with the three pillars of sustainability: environmental requirements, societal energy demand, and electricity market prices.
